android.runtime: V8 (NativeScript Android runtime); JavaScript shipped as minified ESM bundles, no bytecode
android.listPrimitive: @nativescript/core ListView (android.widget.ListView with a BaseAdapter), fixed rowHeight 72
android.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream behind the transport interface (default); WebSocket transport not implemented yet
android.persistence: file in the app files directory, temp file + rename

ios.runtime: V8 (NativeScript iOS runtime, NativeScript/ios-spm Swift package); JavaScript shipped as minified ESM bundles
ios.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream behind the transport interface (default); WebSocket transport not implemented yet
ios.persistence: file in Application Support, atomic write

R1.reason: Insights is part of the installed artifact (embedded mode).

R2.reason: No runtime code-loading mechanism is documented for NativeScript; the CLI's bundler options (webpack, rspack, vite) are build-time only.

R7.reason: Single JavaScript runtime; no second UI runtime to communicate with.

R8.reason: JavaScript calls native APIs through the NativeScript runtime's synchronous marshalling.

sync.mechanism: NativeScript direct native call (synchronous marshalling on the UI thread)

async.reason: NativeScript calls native APIs directly and synchronously; it has no asynchronous bridge.

deviations.summary: BenchKit is implemented inside the candidate (TypeScript over direct native calls) because the shared BenchKit libraries do not exist yet; iOS has no OSSignposter events, touch observer, proc.anchor or memory checkpoints.

The default data source replays the bundled stream frames in-app on the monotonic clock with the server's absolute schedule; checkpoints come from the end frame (mb.replayCount) and from background only, because there is no control channel.
mb.server, mb.token, mb.dataset=network, mb.remote=remote, mb.bridgeBench and mb.layoutProbe are not implemented; such values are reported as launch-config-invalid and the defaults are used.
@nativescript/theme and the template splash/launch images are not used, storage permissions are removed, allowBackup is off, orientation is portrait only.
R8 is on with keep rules for the runtime, androidx, material and kotlin packages and without renaming; resource shrinking is off because resources are resolved by name from JavaScript.

confounds.summary: The NativeScript Android runtime pins its own Gradle/AGP (8.14.3 / 8.12.1), so the R8 version differs from other candidates.
The replay stream files (about 0.46 MB per profile, uncompressed) are bundled in the artifact; size reports must subtract the benchmark-data category.
Updates are produced by an in-app timer instead of arriving from a socket; the receive path differs from candidates that use the WebSocket stream.
